description: Resolve the Git merge conflicts of a working directory -- of an in-progress merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, stash apply, or of conflict markers left by patch -- carefully and semantically, never losing any change, escalate unresolvable hunks as-is, continue the in-progress operation, and emit a RESOLVED, PARTIAL, NONE, or FAILED verdict. Use when the user calls to "resolve" or "fix" merge conflicts.
